TDK Corp Reports Steady Export Growth Amid Stable Demand for Electronic Components

TOKYO, June 13 – TDK Corp, a leading manufacturer in Japan’s technology hardware sector, reported steady export growth in the latest trade figures, reflecting resilient global demand for electronic components. According to data released Thursday, TDK Corp’s overseas shipments rose 4.2% in May compared to the same month last year, with growth attributed to sustained orders from manufacturers of consumer electronics and industrial equipment.

Company officials said the uptick was driven by demand for capacitors, sensors, and magnetic materials, particularly in markets across Asia and North America. “We are seeing robust interest in our advanced electronic components, especially from partners in the automotive electronics and telecommunications sectors,” said Hiroshi Tanaka, a spokesperson for TDK Corp. “Our production lines have remained stable, and we are working closely with logistics providers to ensure timely delivery.”

Exports to Southeast Asia and the United States saw the highest year-on-year gains, up 6.5% and 5.8% respectively, while shipments to Europe remained largely unchanged. Analysts say the figures suggest the company is benefitting from ongoing investment in 5G infrastructure and the gradual recovery in industrial automation following recent supply chain constraints.

“The numbers are in line with expectations for Japan’s technology hardware industry, which continues to show resilience in the face of shifting global demand patterns,” said Keiko Ueda, an analyst at Sakura Market Insights. “TDK Corp’s focus on innovation and supply chain stability has positioned it well for steady export performance.”

Industry groups welcomed the figures, noting that stable trade flows support employment and growth in the sector. “Japanese hardware producers have worked hard to diversify their customer base and maintain high quality standards,” said Akira Saito, director of the Japan Electronics Trade Association. “This consistency is crucial for the health of our export-driven economy.”

Domestic sales for TDK Corp remained steady, with no significant fluctuations reported. The company said it plans to continue investing in research and development to meet future demand for next-generation electronic materials. No disruptions to production or supply chains were reported during the period.
